candidates.description: Residue Solo is a durational performance built around a single, distilled movement. As the final work in a three-part series, it carries forward the larger project’s gradual reduction of form, arriving at an action that is repeated, sustained, and allowed to change through time. The performance attends to endurance, repetition, and the subtle shifts that emerge when there is nowhere else to go. How can we communicate when words fail? If the need is desperate enough, can we escape language and still be understood?
The Voynich Manuscript is a real, 15th century codex written in an unknown language. Alongside 240 pages of text in a unique alphabet, it depicts people bathing in strange contraptions, botanical details of unknown plants, and astrological star charts unlike any on earth. Some scholars suggest it is a complex hoax, yet text analysis and information theory suggest the letter and word frequency match those of a real language.

The show weaves together stories and anecdotes starting with childhood and follows him on the road to Niagara Falls, Las Vegas and further, incorporating several astounding monologues and rants he wrote.
